note: Method: IMSLP author categories; IMSLP Category:Methods/Studies/Exercises intersected with the violin categories; IMSLP title searches and page comments; IMSLP 'List of works by ...' pages (Hofmeister/Pazdírek/SBB-based) for list-only titles; DNB SRU catalogue; archive.org OCR (Joachim-Moser TOC, Wessely scan); Wikipedia; Schott. No score PDFs were opened. (1) The repo helper lists only the main author category and ignores IMSLP 'query-continue' (categories over 500 pages are truncated); methods such as Joachim's Violin School, David's Violinschule, Wilhelmj's Modern School and Courvoisier's Ecole de la Vélocité sit in Category:Methods or '<Author>/Books' and appear only via title search; IMSLP page COMMENTS/Extra fields (e.g. '{{EVln}} first pos.') decide several floor questions. (2) 'German' tradition here includes Austrian and Swiss authors (Dont, Mayseder, Hellmesberger, Müller, Zehetmair, Klasinc, Courvoisier, Heim, Lehmann). Casorti (French), Halíř (Czech) and Marteau (French) are outside that slice but their listed books are German-published bowing/scale books. (3) Confidence 'low' = existence only from an IMSLP works list or a single secondary source (Eichberg, G. Eberhardt Opp. 81/83/92 and Beiträge, Hoya and Venzl list titles, Marteau Op. 19, Dont Opp. 54-55, Abel Neue Folge, Havemann, Klasinc Bd 4). Levels are estimates; almost none of these books appear on ABRSM/RCM syllabi, 'level_basis' states the evidence. (4) Joachim-Moser: original 1905 volumes are I Anfangsunterricht, II Lagenstudien, III Vortragstudien; the Simrock/Jacobsen reissue (1959) re-divides them as Bd 1 T1 beginners, Bd 1 T2 positions 1-3, Bd 2 T1 shifting, Bd 2 T2 progressive studies, Bd 3 T1-3 masterworks. Only Band II is listed. (5) Wilhelmj/Brown Modern School: 6 books each in A/B parts exist but only Books 1-2 are digitised; Books 3-6 unverifiable. (6) Nothing found for Böhm, Heermann (only an edition of Bériot's École transcendentale), Wirth, Rosé or Georg Hellmesberger; Klingler and Rostal wrote treatises (their editions of Rode/Dont/Flesch are editions of existing works). Spohr's pupils: only David and Hubert Ries left study material. (7) Overlap with the Kayser/Wohlfahrt slice (german_a.json): Seybold Op. 182, Kross, Scholz, Nowotny, Küchler Op. 13, Courvoisier, Mayseder, Essek, Scharwenka-Stresow, S.
